Core Infrastructure¶

The core module provides fundamental infrastructure components used throughout NEXUS.

Logging¶

Basic logging configuration for NEXUS.

nexus.core.logging.setup_logging(level: int = 20, log_file: str = 'nexus.log') → None[source]¶

Set up basic logging configuration.

Parameters:

  • level – Logging level (e.g., logging.DEBUG, logging.INFO)

  • log_file – Path to log file

Get a logger instance.

Parameters:

name – Logger name (usually __name__)

Returns:

Configured logger instance
